patents.title: Lattice support structure that breaks away cleanly after printing
Vibration-Compensated Solenoid Valve Assembly for Agricultural UAV Spray Payloads
patents.abstract: The invention describes a solenoid nozzle valve assembly incorporating a mechanical anti-vibration sleeve and an adaptive current-drive circuit that adjusts coil energisation timing as a function of real-time accelerometer readings from the UAV flight controller. The design reduces actuation delay variation caused by airframe vibration from a measured range of 8–31 ms to 4–7 ms across tested frequency bands (0.5–80 Hz), improving spatial accuracy of variable-rate spray commands at UAV operating speeds up to 6 m s⁻¹. Filed with the Intellectual Property Office of the Republic of Serbia, co-inventors Aleksandar Đurić and Nemanja Varga.

patents.title: Gasket groove profile with graduated side-wall draft angle for polymer lid enclosures subject to differential thermal expansion
patents.abstract: A groove cross-section geometry for seating elastomeric O-rings in polymer enclosure lids is described, in which the side-wall draft angle varies from 5° at the groove base to 12° at the opening. This graduated geometry distributes contact stress more uniformly along the O-ring circumference when the lid material and the metal frame to which it is mounted undergo differential thermal expansion. The design reduces peak stress at groove corners by approximately 20 % compared with uniform-draft grooves of equivalent depth, without requiring changes to standard O-ring dimensions. The groove can be machined or moulded and is applicable to lids manufactured from glass-fibre-reinforced polyester or polycarbonate.

patents.title: Method and apparatus for in-process kinematic recalibration of a multi-axis robot arm using on-board temperature sensors and a sparse external measurement system
patents.abstract: The invention discloses a recalibration system for articulated robot arms comprising a set of resistance temperature detectors distributed across robot joints, an interface to a sparse external position measurement device such as a laser tracker, and an on-controller filter algorithm that combines temperature readings with intermittent position measurements to update the robot's kinematic parameter table in real time. The method enables continuous accuracy recovery during production operation without requiring the robot to move to a dedicated calibration pose. Claims cover the sensor placement selection procedure, the filter update law, and the controller integration interface.

patents.title: Method and system for parametric generation and constraint-propagation update of folding-carton dielines from dimensional input data
patents.abstract: A computer-implemented method for generating a folding-carton dieline from a set of user-supplied internal dimensions. The method constructs a directed acyclic graph of geometric features, each defined by one or more algebraic expressions referencing master dimension variables. On modification of any master variable, the system propagates changes through the graph and regenerates all dependent feature geometries without user intervention. The generated dieline is exported in CFF2 and SVG formats. The system includes validation checks for minimum flap width, glue-flap overlap, and tuck-tongue clearance against user-configurable tolerance tables.

patents.title: Method and Circuit Arrangement for Dead-Time Adaptive Control in Bidirectional LLC/CLLC Resonant Converters
patents.abstract: A method for adaptively adjusting dead time in a bidirectional LLC or CLLC resonant converter based on a real-time estimate of MOSFET output charge derived from measured drain-source voltage slope during the commutation interval. A low-cost analogue differentiator circuit and a comparator threshold circuit feed a dead-time correction signal to the gate driver. The approach eliminates the need for a current sensor for dead-time optimisation and maintains ZVS across a battery terminal voltage range spanning at least 40 % of nominal. The patent covers the circuit topology and the associated control algorithm.

patents.title: Method and apparatus for adaptive superheat control in a positive-displacement expander organic Rankine cycle unit
patents.abstract: The patent describes a control method for maintaining expander inlet superheat within a defined safe band in ORC units equipped with scroll or screw expanders, using a combination of pump-speed modulation and a partial-bypass valve positioned upstream of the expander. The method includes an adaptive gain-scheduling scheme that adjusts PI controller parameters based on an estimated heat-source enthalpy flow computed from available temperature and flow-rate measurements. The invention is applicable to ORC units operating with working fluids in the molecular weight range of 100–250 g/mol and heat-source temperatures between 80 and 220 °C. The patent was filed jointly by the University of Novi Sad and a regional engineering firm.

patents.title: Method for continuous enzymatic synthesis of pharmaceutical-grade phosphatidylcholine using immobilised lipase in a packed-bed reactor
patents.abstract: The invention describes a process for producing phosphatidylcholine of pharmaceutical purity (≥96%) by continuous enzymatic transesterification of lysophosphatidylcholine with fatty acid acyl donors in a packed-bed reactor containing lipase immobilised on acrylic carrier beads. The method specifies substrate feed ratios, solvent composition, water activity control, temperature range, and flow rate parameters that together yield volumetric productivity above 4 g/L·h with enzyme operational lifetime exceeding 20 days. A downstream module for solvent removal and aqueous dispersion of the product is also claimed.
